title.narrative: Government to Government (G2G) - Zomba District Council

description.narrative: (Malawi): In line with USAID's vision of system strengthening for greater sustainability and resilience, USAID/Malawi entered into a direct three-year Government-to-Government (G2G) agreement with the Zomba District Council (ZDC). This integrated health activity supports the implementation of maternal and child health; family planning and reproductive health; nutrition; tuberculosis and HIV services. FY 2021 funds will enable the ZDC to: 1) implement the family health package of services through integrated outreach visits; 2) procure essential equipment; 3) provide supportive supervision; and 4) strengthen on-the-job mentoring to promote quality of care at both facility and community levels. The activity will support the 151 priority health care workers and four support staff recruited for ZDC using the Government of Malawi's recruitment and salary payment systems. This activity is complemented by a separate USAID award to the Government of Malawi's Ministry of Finance to support salary payments for the health care workers and support staff workers until the Government of Malawi absorbs them within the three year award period. Direct G2G support to decentralized districts with strong political will, sufficient devolved authority, and an acceptable capacity level will enhance Malawi's pathway to locally led development through strengthened capacity and commitment of the government to build sustainable and resilient health systems; ensure long-term sustainability, increase efficiency, strengthen transparency, and promote accountability. This activity supports the Integrated Country Strategy Mission Objective 1.2 - Public service providers improve the integrity and quality of public services, particularly those supported with U.S. foreign assistance and 3.2 - Malawi improves access to and quality of health services so that more of its citizens gain and retain full health and are able to contribute productively at home, in the community, and at work..
